description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Minion's Return by paying {2}{B}, attaching it to Heliod.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
